entities.name: Treaty on the Establishment of Peace throughout Christendom

entities.summary: The Tractatus pacis toti Christianitati fiendae, or Treaty on the Establishment of Peace throughout Christendom, was the unsuccessful project of universal peace initiated by King George of Bohemia in the 15th century.
